title: In-Place Home Resale Purchase Agreement Standard Conditions
content:
**Standard conditions of a purchase agreement on an In-Place Home Resale file.**

**A. Acceptance.** Accepting an offer is the seller's own act and binds the home to that buyer until the agreement closes or is cancelled. A purchase agreement may be signed only while the home is listed; the file's status on the company's records decides this before the agreement is signed.

**B. Earnest money.** On every package except the Resale Approval Service, the buyer's earnest money must be at least the package's minimum earnest-money percentage of the sale price, and it is held by Hearthstone Home Sales until closing.

**C. Buyer deadlines.** The buyer must submit a residency application for the seller's site within the package's application deadline in calendar days after the agreement date, and a buyer financing the purchase must obtain loan approval within the package's financing contingency in calendar days after it.

**D. Cancellation with refund.** The agreement is cancelled and the earnest money refunded to the buyer when the buyer's residency application is denied, or when financing is denied within the contingency period.

**E. Cancellation with forfeiture.** The agreement is cancelled and the earnest money forfeited when the buyer misses the residency application deadline, withdraws after the contingency period, or fails to close within the package's closing deadline after residency approval. Hearthstone Home Sales retains the package's share percentage of a forfeited deposit and the rest goes to the seller.

**F. Return to market.** A cancelled agreement returns the home to the market on the same listing term.

**G. Seller backing out.** A seller who wants to back out of a signed agreement is outside what the resident desk can arrange, and the request goes to a human representative.

| Event | Agreement | Earnest money |
|---|---|---|
| Residency application denied | cancelled | refunded to the buyer |
| Financing denied within the contingency period | cancelled | refunded to the buyer |
| Residency application deadline missed | cancelled | forfeited |
| Buyer withdraws after the contingency period | cancelled | forfeited |
| Buyer fails to close within the closing deadline after residency approval | cancelled | forfeited |

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreement on the Full-Service Resale Brokerage)

Sale price 48000.00; minimum earnest money 5.0 percent, so the deposit must be at least 2400.00. A deposit of 2400.00 meets the minimum; a deposit of 2399.99 does not. If that 2400.00 deposit is forfeited, Hearthstone Home Sales retains 50.0 percent, 1200.00, and the seller receives the other 1200.00.
